question:
Simplify the following expression.
(60 + 64 ÷ 4 of 4) × {1000 ÷ ((10 of (3 + 2)) × 2 of 5)) – 28 + (100 × 3 of 3)
(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 1000.

(60 + 64 ÷ 4 of 4) × {1000 ÷ ((10 of (3 + 2) × 2 of 5)} – 28 + (100 × 3 of 3)
⇒ (60 + 64 ÷ 16) × {1000 ÷ (50 × 10)} – 28 + (900) 
⇒ 64 × 2 – 28 + 900
⇒ 128 – 28 + 900 = 1000

question:
If \(3(16^3 – 6^3 )\over(16^2 + 6^2 + Q)\) = 30, then find Q?
(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 96.

\(3(16^3 – 6^3 )\over(16^2 + 6^2 + Q)\)
x3 – y3 = (x – y) (x2 + y2 + xy)
⇒ \((16 – 6)(16^2+6^2+96)\over(16^2+6^2+Q)\) = 10 
⇒ \((16^2+6^2+96)\over(16^2+6^2+Q)\) = 1 

 ⇒ 162 + 62 + 96 = 162 + 62 + Q

∴ Q = 96

question:
Which of the following can be the value of k if \((88÷8×k–3×3)\over(6^2–7×5+k^2 )\) = 1?
(CGL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 1, 10.

\((88÷8×k–3×3)\over(6^2–7×5+k^2 )\) = 1
⇒ 11k – 9 = 36 – 35 + k2
⇒ 11k – 9 = 1 + k2
⇒ k2 – 11k + 10 = 0
⇒ k2 – 10k – k + 10 = 0
⇒ k(k – 10) – 1(k – 10) = 0
⇒ (k – 1) (k – 10) = 0
⇒ k = 1, 10

question:
3p – [\(3p-(\overline{p+q})\) – {\(3p-(p-(\overline{q–p}))\)}] 
(CHSL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 2p + 2q.

3p – [\(3p-(\overline{p+q})\) – {\(3p-(p-(\overline{q–p}))\)}]  
⇒ 3p – [\(3p-(\overline{p+q})\) – {3p – (2p – q)}]
⇒ 3p – [\(3p-(\overline{p+q})\) – {p + q}]
⇒ 3p – [\(3p-(\overline{p+q})\) – p – q]
⇒ 3p – [3p – p – q – p – q]
⇒ 3p – [p – 2q]
⇒ 2p + 2q

question:
If [\(3\frac{6}{7}\) ÷ \(54\over7\) – {3 – (\(2\frac{3}{4}\) – \(3\over2\))}] + A ÷ 4 = 0, then what is the value of A?
(CHSL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 5.

[\(3\frac{6}{7}\) ÷ \(54\over7\) – {3 – (\(2\frac{3}{4}\) – \(3\over2\))}] + A ÷ 4 = 0
[\(27\over7\) ÷ \(54\over7\) – {3 – \(5\over4\)}] + A ÷ 4 = 0 
[\(1\over2\) – \(7\over4\)] + A ÷ 4 = 0 
\(–5\over4\) + \(A\over4\) = 0 
\(–5+A\over4\) = 0 
∴ A = 5
